newsitem.title: CANADA: SOCCER-CANADA SHOCKS COSTA RICA IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CANADA SHOCKS COSTA RICA IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Substitute midfielder Eddy Berdusco gave Canada their first goal in five matches in the final round of CONCACAF World Cup qualifying to lift the Canadians to a 1-0 win Sunday over Costa Rica.
Berdusco, who replaced Carlo Corazzin after halftime, tapped a crossing pass from Fernando Aguiar past Costa Rican goalkeeper Eric Lonnis in the 68th minute.
"I guess I feel like a little bit of a hero," said Berdusco. "It was an important game for us and to get that winning goal feels really good.
Costa Rica (2-2-1) remained in second place behind Mexico in the six-team table.
Victory allowed Canada to stay in the hunt for a World Cup berth next year in France.
Canada (1-2-2) sits in a third-place tie with the United States and Jamaica. The top three teams from the six-team playdown advance to France.
Canada travels to Jamaica for a September 7 game in Kingston and then plays El Salvador on September 14 before it takes on the front-running Mexicans in Edmonton on October 12.
Costa Rica next plays at home against El Salvador on August 10 before travelling to Portland, Oregon, to face the United States on September 7.
